newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 20.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in May 21 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The activity of Japan's Aum Shinri Kyo sect in Russia seems to be closely linked a former top Kremlin official, named by the paper, and his positions with a number of Russian organisations which were granted extensive tax breaks
- The army buys 10,000 tonnes of sugar in the first ever open, public tender for military supplies
- The government is ready to ban most of the privileges enjoyed by state officials in order to raise funds to pay off long backlogs in pensions and public sector by June 30
